name: LLM Demo
tagline: Run an LLM completion directly or through a bundled Executa.
description:
LLM Demo shows the two ways an Anna App can reach a language model. It can call `anna.llm.complete` directly from the window — including MCP `{type:'image'}` content blocks so a vision model can see an attached image — or invoke a bundled Python Executa (`llm-via-executa`) that turns around and calls `sampling/createMessage` back to the host LLM via reverse-RPC (text-only). It also exercises `anna.agent.session`.

**What's inside**

- A static single-window UI (`static-spa`) with controls for the direct and Executa-backed paths, plus an image input for the direct path.
- `llm-via-executa` — Python stdio Executa that wraps host `sampling/createMessage`.

**How to use**

Open the window and trigger a completion via either path; compare the direct `anna.llm.complete` result with the Executa round-trip. Attach an image (file or public HTTPS URL) to see the model answer from the image in the same completion.
_comment_bundled_executas: Executas that ship inside this app. `anna-app apps publish` publishes each one first, then substitutes its server-minted tool_id into every `bundled:<handle>` reference in manifest.json (in memory — the file on disk is never mutated). The `llm-via-executa` handle maps to ./executas/llm-via-executa-python.
